validate.title: Check the profiles file
validate.description:
{report}

Phone location is not always reliable. In stations, tunnels, or with battery saving on, your position can be late or wrong. Location only helps the companion. It never hides a warning about your train.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Changing the phone or the alert style sends the test notifications again.

data_description.profiles_path: Full path to your profiles file. Copy the starter file there first.
data_description.notify_service: The phone that gets the alerts. Both test notifications go to it.
data_description.loud_style: How a loud alert arrives. Quiet updates are always silent.
data_description.notifications_enabled_entity: Optional. Off pauses phone notifications and alert events. Relevant alerts wait without a failed delivery. Missing or unknown states leave notifications enabled.
data_description.notifications_quiet_entity: Optional. On makes phone notifications silent. Alert events keep their original severity. Missing or unknown states use the selected alert style.

test.title: Did both arrive?
test.description: A loud and a silent test notification were sent to notify.{service}.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Every alert is also sent as signed JSON to these URLs. Saving a change first sends each URL a signed loud and a signed silent test, which it must accept. Your phone stays the proof that alerts arrive.

data_description.webhook_urls: One URL per line. Leave empty to turn webhooks off.
data_description.webhook_secret: At least 16 characters. Give the same secret to the receiver.
data_description.webhook_token: Optional. Only for receivers that want a token, such as OpenClaw. Sent to every URL.

error.file_missing: No profiles file at {path}. Copy the starter file there first (examples/profiles.yaml in the repository).

error.bad_webhook_url: Each line must be an http or https URL without a user name or password.
error.weak_webhook_secret: The secret must be at least 16 characters, or a valid whsec_ value.
error.weak_webhook_token: The token must be at least 16 characters of plain ASCII, without spaces.
error.webhook_test_failed: A test send was not accepted: {failed}. Check the receiver, its secret and its token, then save again.
error.invalid_profile: The profile is not valid. Review the report above.

error.save_failed: The file could not be saved. Check its folder permissions. Existing contents were not replaced.
error.invalid_auth: NS rejected this key. Reconfigure the integration with a valid key.
error.cannot_connect: The station list could not be retrieved from NS. Try again.
error.recovery_refused: The action was refused. Read the current journey and prepare again if needed.
error.recovery_acknowledgement: Confirm the physical place and required limits before continuing.
error.arrival_refused: The arrival was not accepted. Read the reason and review this journey again.
error.arrival_acknowledgement: Confirm your personal arrival only after reviewing the destination, time and plan.
error.arrival_time: Choose a valid Amsterdam date and time. For a repeated autumn hour, select its offset.
error.settings_changed: The settings changed while this form was open. Review the current settings and try again.

abort.no_mobile_app: No phone with the Home Assistant companion app was found.
abort.profile_saved: Profile saved. The running companion reloads valid profile changes automatically.
abort.recovery_unavailable: No usable recovery or active recovery action is available. The companion must be running.
abort.recovery_selected: Recovery selected. Use the bound recovery buttons to confirm boarding and arrival. No profile settings were changed.
abort.recovery_action_saved: Recovery action saved. The next step has its own confirmation. No profile settings were changed.
abort.arrival_unavailable: No saved journey is available, or the companion is not running.
